mode: retrospective chronological research; all historical intervals were previously accessible and viewed

selection.family: all 30 existing and proposed factors, primary horizon only
selection.development: positive mean Rank IC and positive mean top-minus-bottom gross return
selection.validation: positive mean Rank IC, positive spread, factor coverage >= 0.8, label coverage >= 0.95, one-sided normal HAC p adjusted with Benjamini-Yekutieli <= 0.1
selection.order: descending validation HAC lower bound, then mean Rank IC, then identifier
selection.correlation_period: validation only; average same-day Spearman on common eligible stocks
selection.fallback: if no new candidate passes, select none; retain the fixed baseline backtests

proxy_residual_rule: same-day OLS: score and proxies winsorized at 1/99 percentiles, intercept plus standardized proxies; no industry or market-cap neutrality claim

backtest.period: followup only; fresh account; lesson-04 course engine
backtest.cost_stress: commission and slippage doubled; sell tax unchanged
backtest.benchmark: same engine and universe, dynamic equal weight, matched capital/costs

stop_rule: run this fixed round once; no formula/direction changes based on followup; no deployment claim
